description:
Along the western coast of North America, a narrow strip of land stretches between the wild Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Cortez. Baja California.

Running for more than 750 miles, it’s the second longest peninsula on Earth.

The land is dry and arid, but the sea is full of life.
